description: Δεδομένα Έγκαιρης Προειδοποίησης Πυρκαγιάς is a dataset listed in data.gov.gr, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Δήμος Πατρέων. Dataset of fire alert notifications generated by remote KED sensors. It includes severity level, confidence percentage, geographic coordinates, sensor recording date, and database insertion date. Coverage: Δήμος Πατρέων. The portal shows the English title as "Early Fire Detection and Warning Data" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Δήμος Πατρέων. Its keywords include Περιβαλλον, φωτιά, αισθητήρες. The listing shows 2 download or service links in CSV, JSON. The listing shows 2026-06-18 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-gr.
